hook: Your Maldives beach can glow blue at night.
title: This Maldives Beach Glows Blue at Night
description:
On Vaadhoo island in the Maldives, waves can light up electric blue at night. The glow comes from tiny bioluminescent plankton that flash when the water moves. It does not happen every night. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Maldives #Bioluminescence
comment_prompt: Would you swim here? Yes or no
